categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo KBE Electrical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of automotive cables. Its product portfolio includes ordinary cables, new energy vehicle cables (high-voltage and charging cables), and data cables used in automotive electrical systems. The company also operates subsidiaries specializing in cable manufacturing and insulating materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing processes to produce automotive cables that meet international standards including German, Japanese, American, and Chinese standards. It employs specialized materials such as PVC, PP, XLPE, silicone, and XLPO for insulation, focusing on high voltage resistance, high temperature tolerance, electromagnetic shielding, and flexibility. Production methods include single-core, coaxial, twisted pair, shielded, and aluminum cables, with rigorous quality control and testing capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive wire harness manufacturers such as Aptiv, Yazaki, Lear, Delphi, Sumitomo, and Furukawa. The company supplies automotive cables to leading global and domestic automobile manufacturers including Volkswagen, General Motors, Ford, BMW, Daimler-Benz, Honda, Toyota, Nissan, Fiat-Chrysler, Volvo, Land Rover, Tesla, SAIC, GAC, Geely, BYD, NIO, Li Auto, XPeng, and Xiaomi Auto. The primary market is the automotive industry, with a significant focus on new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates multiple production bases across China including Ningbo, Benxi, Chengdu, Shanghai, Huizhou, and Macheng, and has expanded internationally with a production base in Mexico. It serves both domestic and international markets, with approximately 91% of revenue from domestic sales and 9% from overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo KBE operates as a secondary supplier in the automotive supply chain, providing automotive cables to primary suppliers (wire harness manufacturers) who then supply to automobile manufacturers. The company is positioned midstream, focusing on component manufacturing and supplying to first-tier suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation in automotive cables, focusing on high-voltage, high-bandwidth, and high-reliability cables to support electric vehicles and intelligent connected vehicles. R&D priorities include developing high-frequency copper cables, data cables for autonomous driving, and cables for humanoid robots. It invests heavily in R&D, holds numerous patents, and participates in international standard-setting organizations. The company also pursues international expansion and diversification into energy storage and AI-related cable products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive cables to wire harness manufacturers. Pricing is based on material costs (mainly copper) plus processing fees, with contracts specifying payment terms such as bank transfers and bank acceptance bills. The company also receives government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major automotive cable and wire harness suppliers domestically and internationally. It holds a leading position in the Chinese automotive cable market, recognized as a strategic and excellent supplier by top wire harness manufacturers. Its brand is strengthened by being the first listed company in its industry in China, with a broad customer base including top global automakers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.65 billion, a 5.68% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 161.65 million, slightly down by 2.59%. Total assets grew by 33.04% to RMB 3.75 billion. The company has shown steady growth with expanding production capacity domestically and internationally, supported by capital market financing and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo KBE differentiates itself through its comprehensive R&D capabilities, adherence to multiple international standards, and ability to customize products to meet diverse customer requirements. Its products emphasize high quality, reliability, and advanced performance characteristics essential for new energy and intelligent vehicles. The company’s strategic geographic layout near automotive clusters and its strong customer service and rapid response capabilities further enhance its competitive advantage.
